name: Evolution
overview: Scripture affirms that God is the sovereign Creator of all things, having made the heavens and the earth by His own power (Genesis 1:1; Isaiah 44:24). Humanity was formed directly by God's hand from the dust and given life through His breath, underscoring a special creation distinct from naturalistic processes (Genesis 2:7). The wisdom and counsel of man cannot stand against the Lord’s design (Proverbs 21:30), and though humans may seek to understand creation, they cannot fully comprehend the works of God (Ecclesiastes 8:17). At the foundation, the eternal Word, who is God, was present at creation, affirming the divine origin of all life (John 1:1).
